rounds.for: Strictly using `bridge_output.description` (DA-004) simplifies the logic and ensures the caption reflects only the explicitly provided information, avoiding potentially unwanted or redundant auto-generated text.
rounds.against: Implementing a fallback to `self._format(payload)` for empty descriptions (DA-005) ensures every video message is informative, improving user experience and preventing uncontextualized media from being sent.
rounds.resolution: The system should prioritize ensuring an informative caption, even if it requires a fallback mechanism for empty primary descriptions.
